# The new-folder sizing attempt changes both initial geometry and persisted-state setup

The owned attempt adds a 40ch minimum width, fixed 200px document height and viewport-sized body, while removing the test head's new-folder persisted-state reset. Accepted source later uses 22rem/18rem minimums and no body viewport dimensions. Its focused menu callback checks at least 235 by 120 after the dialog gains focus. Those are distinct geometry/test phases; neither the patch subject nor this static comparison proves the intermittent failure was cured.

Scope: New folder dialog size lifecycle.
